arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ.
transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi lak, wa shacartal-waahib, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah.
translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.

arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ.
transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka wa baaraka 'alayk, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa ajzala thawaabak.
translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly. (Reply of the person being congratulated)
